features.description: Per-character epistemic memory — one world state, 5 filtered views; a character cannot act on facts they did not witness, were not told, and could not infer. See project_context.md §5.3.
features.evidence: SUBSTRATE BUILT AND TESTED (KB-04, KB-07, KB-08): store.visible_to(fork, knower, chapter) filters by telling-time AND knower scope; leak suite asserts by SET EQUALITY across cutoffs; graph and working-memory both inherit the guard at construction. GAP TO CLOSE: knower_scope is populated per fact but nothing yet DERIVES it from Scene.witnesses — that propagation step is what makes §4.2's compounding acceptance condition hold across turns. Also note project_context.md §5.3 wants three channels (witnessed/told/inferred); we store one set.

features.description: Canon Kernel domain schema — tri-temporal facts (story/telling/record time), forks, entities, scenes with presence grades, commitments, flags, plus pure invariant predicates
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s6): M0 built across 5 TDD tasks, each independently reviewed (spec-compliance + quality), plus a whole-branch review on the most capable model. Then hardened: tz-aware datetimes enforced, record-time ordering validated, revealed_at/AUDIENCE coupling closed.

features.description: Canon store — CanonStorePort + SQLite adapter with lossless Fact<->Row mapping, tri-temporal as-of queries, and ATOMIC supersession (close old window + insert replacement in one transaction)
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s6): round-trip asserts full-model equality (not identity), None-vs-empty-frozenset distinction preserved across the JSON boundary, and durability proven by closing the engine and reopening against the same file.

features.description: Temporal invariants + spoiler-guard leak suite — set-equality assertions across cutoffs, scope leaks, and the severity asymmetry (a leak fails the build; over-withholding is a reported metric)
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s6): leak assertions use SET EQUALITY, not spot checks — spot checks only catch leaks you already thought of. Parametrized across cutoffs. Caught and fixed a real bug: superseded facts were being hidden at every chapter, including ones inside their own valid window.

features.description: Graph projection layer — derived adjacency over canon facts with multi-hop traversal, cycle-safe BFS, and relationship diff between two story-time positions
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s6): guard applied at CONSTRUCTION inside from_facts(), not left to callers — an unguarded graph beside a guarded store is a spoiler side-channel, and traversal is exactly how you would reach a withheld fact. No graph database: a service dependency would break the offline constraint.

features.description: Agent working memory — bounded, deterministic per-character packet (visible facts + its own guarded graph + a withheld count)
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s6): deterministic assembly (identical inputs -> identical packet), focus entities survive the budget on BOTH fact endpoints, and assembly reads only from store.visible_to() so there is no second filtering path to leak through.

features.description: Vector store — semantic recall with the spoiler guard applied as a pre-filter, plus a dependency-free deterministic embedder behind an EmbedderPort
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s6): guard filters BEFORE ranking — a post-filter on top-k silently returns fewer than k and hides the leak in the gap. Offline hashing embedder is the demo-safe default; Databricks Vector Search plugs in as a second adapter behind the same port (Delta Sync + HYBRID search + server-side filters).

features.description: End-to-end memory storage — the full hybrid (canon store + graph + working memory) driven against a real on-disk database across TWO restarts, with the guard asserted at every layer
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s6): ingest -> close engine -> reopen -> guard before and after the reveal -> epistemic scope -> supersede -> reopen again. Never :memory:. Bar set deliberately above the reference implementations: Graphiti's own suite round-trips temporal edges then asserts only on uuid, and one of its search tests has no assertions at all.
